title: DigiLIB
desc: An intelligent research assistant for academic libraries, exploring how far LLMs can go in making research genuinely easier to navigate. Pitched at the Bardusch Family IdeaMakers Challenge, 2026 (2nd place).
short: An intelligent research assistant for academic libraries, exploring how far LLMs can go in making research genuinely easier to navigate.

title: WeatherDrive
desc: Weather along the drive, at the time you will actually be there. The prototype samples the route geometry instead of just the two endpoints, asks for the forecast at each waypoint's real arrival hour, and has an LLM write the briefing a driver wants before setting out. Weather delays cost US roads close to $8.7 billion by 2012, and trucking still had no tool built for it.
short: Weather along the drive at the time you will actually be there: route-shaped forecasts, plus an LLM briefing before you set out.

title: LLM Proof Generator
desc: Type a theorem, get a typeset proof back as a PDF. Two model calls in sequence: one writes the proof, the second only reformats it as LaTeX, then pdflatex compiles it. Written in February 2025, when a model could write LaTeX but could not hand you a file, so every hop from text to PDF was wired by hand.
short: Type a theorem, get a LaTeX proof as a PDF. Built in February 2025, before tool use: the path from model output to compiled file was wired by hand.

title: AI Virtual Assistant
desc: A Python virtual assistant built on OpenAI's API: context, tools, and real tasks rather than canned commands. An early, deliberate take on what an assistant could become.
short: A Python virtual assistant built on OpenAI's API: context, tools, and real tasks rather than canned commands.

title: School IoT
desc: An IoT system designed for classrooms to save money on electricity, built and presented at the CBSE Science Fair 2022 with a working demo on video.

title: Star Classifier
desc: An early applied-ML project: classifying stars from data with a trained model; one of the builds that pointed everything toward AI.

title: My Rover Project
desc: A rover built from the ground up and documented in a ten-minute walkthrough: wiring, drive, and control in one build.
short: A rover built from the ground up and documented in a ten-minute walkthrough: wiring, drive, and control in one build.

title: Room Automation
desc: A full automation pass over my own room: a four-channel relay board and an HC-05 Bluetooth module putting lights and fan under phone control; lived with daily for months while the bugs got worked out.

title: Mini Greenhouse
desc: The automated garden, evolved into a self-regulating mini greenhouse: soil, rain, and light sensors decide when to water. Presented at the CBSE Science Fair 2019, with the full build on video.
